theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Small Steps, Big Wealth: SIP Magic Explained
body: Invest regularly, irrespective of market ups and downs. Over time, your money works harder through compounding growth.
caption: SIPs let you invest fixed amounts consistently, smoothing out market volatility. Compounding turns your contributions into substantial wealth over decades. Start small, stay disciplined, watch it grow. #SIPInvesting #CompoundingPower #RupeeCostAveraging #WealthBuilding #InvestingFundamentals
